title: I-Trust Ephathiswe uMfula
intro: Umphefumulo wabhekana nesinqumo esingenakwenzeka, lapho impilo yosana olusanda kuzalwa yayilenga khona. Uqondiswa ukuphefumulelwa kwaphezulu, umyalo onzima walalelwa, futhi imfihlo eyigugu yasuswa emsinga, kodwa yabuyiselwa ngendlela engalindelekile.
clues: Bengiphila ngaphansi komthunzi wombusi owayelawula ukubulawa kwabesilisa abasanda kuzalwa.
Kwafika ugqozi oluvela kuNkulunkulu kimi, lwangiyala ukuba ngithathe isinyathelo sokuphelelwa yithemba nesibuhlungu.
Ngafaka usana lwami oluyigugu ebhokisini ngalibeka emfuleni ogelezayo.
Inhliziyo yami yaba yize, futhi ngacishe ngadalula imfihlo, kodwa u-Allah waqinisa ukuzimisela kwami.
Ngithumele othile ukuba alandele uhambo lwengane ehla ngomfula njengoba umsinga uthwala isifuba.
Ingane yatholwa yindlu yomashiqela, futhi ekugcineni, ngahlangana nengane yami futhi ngaba ngumnakekeli.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
